reason: Balance graph is exposed as a plain button with no pressed state, so a screen reader user cannot tell it is not the current view. The two icon buttons switch the Mercury balance card between graph and table. Their names are fine, but neither has aria-pressed or aria-checked: the selected view shows only as a border, fill and icon color (class _selected), so 4.1.2 and 1.3.1 fail. The view can still be switched and the change is visible in the page, so the impact is minor.

Balance table, the current view, is exposed as a plain button with no pressed state, and it has tabindex=-1 so Tab skips it. The two icon buttons switch the Mercury balance card between graph and table. Their names are fine, but neither has aria-pressed or aria-checked: the selected view shows only as a border, fill and icon color (class _selected), so 4.1.2 and 1.3.1 fail. The view can still be switched and the change is visible in the page, so the impact is minor.
